WITH source_escrow__deposit AS (SELECT * FROM escrow__deposit WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND collector = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e'),
source_escrow__withdraw AS (SELECT * FROM escrow__withdraw WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND collector = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e'),
source_escrow__escrow_collected AS (SELECT * FROM escrow__escrow_collected WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND collector = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e'),
source_escrow__thaw AS (SELECT * FROM escrow__thaw WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND collector = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e'),
source_escrow__cancel_thaw AS (SELECT * FROM escrow__cancel_thaw WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND collector = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e'),
source_tally__payment_collected AS (SELECT * FROM tally__payment_collected WHERE block_number <= 506000000 AND payer = '0xdde4cffd3d9052a9cb618fc05a1cd02be1f2f467' AND receiver = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4'),
escrow_movement AS (SELECT payer, collector, receiver, CAST(tokens AS BIGNUM) AS delta FROM source_escrow__deposit
UNION ALL
SELECT payer, collector, receiver, -CAST(tokens AS BIGNUM) FROM source_escrow__withdraw
UNION ALL
SELECT payer, collector, receiver, -CAST(tokens AS BIGNUM) FROM source_escrow__escrow_collected),
escrow_thaw_update AS (SELECT payer, collector, receiver, tokens AS amount, "thawEndTimestamp" AS deadline,
       block_number, log_index FROM source_escrow__thaw
UNION ALL
SELECT payer, collector, receiver, '0', '0', block_number, log_index FROM source_escrow__cancel_thaw
UNION ALL
SELECT payer, collector, receiver, '0', '0', block_number, log_index FROM source_escrow__withdraw),
escrow_identity AS (SELECT payer, collector, receiver FROM escrow_movement
UNION
SELECT payer, collector, receiver FROM escrow_thaw_update
UNION
SELECT payer, '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e', receiver FROM source_tally__payment_collected),
payments_escrow_account AS (WITH balance AS (
    SELECT payer, collector, receiver, sum(delta) AS amount
    FROM escrow_movement GROUP BY payer, collector, receiver
), thaw AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer, collector, receiver ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC) AS rank
    FROM escrow_thaw_update
)
SELECT i.payer || substr(i.collector, 3) || substr(i.receiver, 3) AS id,
       i.payer, i.collector, i.receiver,
       coalesce(CAST(b.amount AS VARCHAR), '0') AS balance,
       coalesce(t.amount, '0') AS "totalAmountThawing",
       coalesce(t.deadline, '0') AS "thawEndTimestamp"
FROM escrow_identity i
LEFT JOIN balance b USING (payer, collector, receiver)
LEFT JOIN thaw t ON t.payer = i.payer AND t.collector = i.collector AND t.receiver = i.receiver AND t.rank = 1)
SELECT id, balance, "totalAmountThawing", "thawEndTimestamp" FROM payments_escrow_account ORDER BY id
scope: One account's four selected balance fields over 13229 independent source logs. Author-written account views run read-only as CTEs on Lodestar's SQL endpoint at the reference block. Signer history and other accounts are not covered.
